selection: Piecewise-constant authored periods; transfer/status events are identity context only and local ratings do not inherit Australia-wide sports evidence.
limitations: All numeric ratings are project estimates with low confidence, not source measurements.
Australia-wide sports evidence is not inherited automatically.
No football federation membership or organised competition is inferred.
Territorial transfer/status is context only, not sports-performance evidence.
No rankings, titles or athlete outcomes are used to fit ratings.
